reason: W565 (#630): forced_pp_pd (the periodically forced predator-prey model of Kuznetsov, Muratori and Rinaldi 1992, tools/models/forced_predator_prey.odex; description W403) with the mesh of the cycles and of the period-doubling curve pd_up cut to 10 intervals and pd_up's step to 0.02: pd_up passes the 1:2 resonance (R2) at (eps, b0) = (1.94893, 2.57025), where the two multipliers near -1 are both -1 (the Poincare map of the model's own equations, docs/studies/w557_special_point_check.py), and AUTO-07p labels it in all 21 runs of NTST 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 60 and 80 with step 0.005, 0.01 and 0.02. xppautX lost it at this setting, where its test (AUTO-07p's abs(EV(3))-1 of the multiplier that is not the imposed one) jumps as the pair swaps roles; its location used up max_location_iterations. docs/studies/w557_r2_repro.py runs all 21.
xppaut_skip: no XPPAUT 8.0 reference for this mesh and step: the card asks for xppautX's own location of the R2 (W565, #630), and XPPAUT 8.0 does not label strong resonances on a two-parameter cycle curve (docs/xppaut-findings.md finding 71)
auto07p_skip: AUTO-07p labels the R2 here as well (W557's 21 runs), but at 10 mesh intervals the two programs' R2 and curve differ by the mesh's own error, 3e-6 in the parameter and 6 samples 2e-6 off in the norm, against 1e-6 to 2e-6 of tolerance, and the mesh's error is 1.8e-5 (xppautX) and 1.5e-5 (AUTO-07p) in eps from the true R2 (the Poincare map of the model's own equations): this card is xppautX's own location of the R2 (W565, #630), pinned by the diagram baseline and docs/studies/w557_r2_repro.py
